scientific_integrity.computational_role: independent finite corroboration for two prime-field planes only
scientific_integrity.literature_comparison: 2008 Levi-graph extremal cycles, 2010 logical-depth survey, targeted published-finding corpus and bibliographic searches
scientific_integrity.proof_scope: all finite projective planes of order at least two, including non-Desarguesian, as a consequence of the projective plane axioms

scientific_limitations: Quantifier-rank-four equivalence concerns ordinary adjacency/equality logic, without counting or named bipartition classes.
The rank-five and named-sort rank-four sharpness comparisons concern the Fano and ternary planes; no higher-rank classification of all planes is asserted.
The finite checker covers only the prime-field planes of orders two and three. Uniformity for every finite plane follows instead from the symbolic incidence casework.
Equivalence to an earlier unindexed or folklore argument cannot be excluded without external independent scrutiny.
title: Four-round logical invisibility of projective-plane incidence graphs
